senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. עקב) [to be curved, bent; denom. עִיקָּר root,]
to uproot, tear loose, detach, remove; to eradicate, undo, abolish, abrogate.
units: <cite ref="Horayot 14a:3">Hor. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>עוֹקֵר הרים</he>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 24a:8">Snh. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>עוקר הרי הרים</he>, v. <cite ref="E00808"><he>הַר</he></cite>.

Ab. III, 17 הרוח באה ועוֹקַרְתּוֹ וכ׳ a wind comes and uproots it and turns it &c. Pesik. Ekha, p. 123ᵃ כל מקום שנאמר ארון עוקר דיורין ומכניס וכ׳ wherever Adon (Master) is mentioned in the Bible, it means (the landlord) that displaces tenants and imports tenants; ib. עוקר כנענים וכ׳ who drives out the Canaanites and brings in the Israelites.
Y. Yeb. I, 2ᵈ; ib. XIII, beg. 13ᵇ ממאנת … לַעֲקוֹר זיקת המת she may (on arriving at majority) refuse the Yabam, which has the effect of annulling her relation to her deceased husband.
<cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>כל עמה מודיי שהיא עוֹקֶרֶת</he> all agree that by doing so she annuls her marriage to her deceased husband.
<cite ref="Pesachim 101b:6">Pes. 101ᵇ</cite> <he>עָקְרוּ רגליהן לצאת</he> when they detached their feet, in order to go.
<cite ref="Shabbat 5a:14">Sabb. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>ע׳ ממקומו וכ׳</he> (sub. <he>רגליו</he>) he moved from his place and received it.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 5:2:10">Y. Bets. V, 63ᵃ</cite> bot., v. <cite ref="S01104"><he>קִיפּוּץ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Megillah 5b:1">Meg. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>בקש לעקור תשעה וכ׳</he> wanted to abolish the fast of the Ninth of Ab.
Pes. 115ᵇ אין עוֹקְרִין את השלחן we do not remove the table (v. comment.); a. v. fr.—Part. pass. עָקוּר; f. עֲקוּרָה; pl. עֲקוּרִים, עְקוּרִין; עֲקוּרוֹת
<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 6:9">Peah VI, 9</cite> <he>תבואה ע׳</he> loose (cut) grain, <he>שאינה ע׳</he> still in the ground.—
senses.label: a

units: <cite ref="Yevamot 64a:8">Yeb. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>יצחק אבינו ע׳ היה</he> Isaac was impotent; <he>שניהם ע׳ היו</he> both of them (Isaac and Rebecca) were impotent.
<cite ref="Yevamot 64a:8">Ib.</cite> <he>מפני מה היו אבותינו ע׳</he> wherefore were our ancestors childless (until they prayed)?; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bekhorot 44b:8">Bekh. 44ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 7:14">Deut. VII, 14</cite> <he>ועקרה</he>) <he>שלא תהא תפלתך ע׳ וכ׳</he> that thy prayer shall not be fruitless before the Lord; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 884">Yalk. Deut. 884</cite> <he>שלא … ע׳ מלפני המקום</he> that thy prayer shall not be removed from before the Lord; <he>שלא יהא ביתך עקור מן התלמידים</he> (not <he>עקורה</he>) that thy house shall not be deprived of scholars.
senses.label: b

senses.gloss: to mutilate, hamstring; to make barren, v. infra.
to be uprooted; to be removed, eradicated, destroyed. Y. Kil. III, 28ᶜ bot. נֶעֶקְרוּ הראשונים if the first seeds have been taken out.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 9:1">Ber. IX, 1</cite> <he>הרואה … מקום שנֶעֶקְרָה וכ׳</he> he who sees … a place from which an idol has been removed (by destruction).

<cite ref="Berakhot 12b:27">Ib. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>לא שתֵּעָקֵר … ממקומה וכ׳</he> not that the memory of the going out from Egypt will be removed from its place (entirely extinct) &c., v. <cite ref="P00666"><he>עִיקָּר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 12b:27">Ib.ᵇ</cite> <he>לא שיֵעָקֵר יעקב וכ׳</he> not that the name of Jacob will entirely fall into disuse; a. fr.
Cant. R. to II, 14 מפני מה הֶעֱקַרְתִּי אתכן why did I decree that you be childless? Because I desired to hear your prayer; Gen. R. s. 45 עִקּרְתִּי Pi. (or עָקַרְתִּי Kal).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 42:3">Gen. R. s. 42</cite> <he>מְעַקַּר בגפנים</he> tried to uproot the vines (destroy the entire nation); <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 11">Lev. R. s. 11</cite>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 11:1">Ib.</cite> <he>המן … לעַקֵּר וכ׳</he> Haman … undertook to destroy the vines; Gen. R. l. c. <he>ביקש לַעֲקוֹר הגפן כלה</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 5:3">Ḥull. V, 3</cite> <he>המעקר</he> he who tears loose the organs to be cut at slaughtering (v. <cite ref="O00710"><he>סִימָן</he></cite>); a. fr.
